allowed.phases: all original session1 acquisition phases, preserve native order; reset EA and bias per acquisition block to avoid discontinuities

sealed.assets: raw EEG, labels, features, predictions and all derived session2 files

model: same nine frozen IV2a source PRS panels used by PRS6875_BipolarGraph_Source external evaluation; never select a panel; existing fixed montage mapping and source normalization; session1 held external to all source training
primary: mean54 of per-person mean9-panel causal ACC gain; bootstrap resamples persons with all nine panels retained together
secondary: batch same aggregation; equal-probability panel ensemble optional descriptive only, never selection
rule: subject-bootstrap95% lower>0:迁移成立; upper<0:有害; otherwise中性
l2: lambda*mean(b_c**2)=lambda*(b0**2+b1**2)/2; same numeric lambda; centered bias; gradient lambda*b for two classes
optimizer: frozen L-BFGS-B maxiter150 gtol1e-8; zero initial two-class bias; center output bias
batch: use current acquisition block only, all unlabelled probabilities; future block data excluded
causal: current and past original probabilities within block only, first20 unchanged, no retroactive revision
labels: session1 labels only for scoring after all54x9 probabilities and corrections hashed and committed; never mounted in correction process
isolation: same OS mount and network isolation as IV2b; only allowlisted session1 staged assets; inaccessible session2 paths and derived caches, file access logs saved
assumption: depends on balanced class prior; not pure zero calibration
historical_exposure: session2 labels used for historical scoring/method reporting; cohort not independent blind; no automatic target-label fitting found in audited direct-transfer paths
preflight: verify all designated checkpoint hashes and fixed montage, session1 native trial identity, class convention and block markers; numerical replay where same-session archive exists; if assets/provenance absent stop and report; do not train
evaluation_scope: 冻结IV2a模型＋校正规则在OpenBMI第1会话上的外部迁移；不代表PRS在OpenBMI上有效，不代表OpenBMI内部LOSO有效性。
historical_boundary: 第2会话已被早先迁移路线读取过EEG和标签并用于报告；本次封存只约束当前分析，不声称其历史未曝光。

class_mapping.operation: After complete four-class PRS fusion, select columns0,1; clip selected probabilities to [1e-12,1]; renormalize each row to sum1; apply frozen binary bias thereafter. Do not combine feet/tongue into hands.
class_mapping.target_labels: verify original OpenBMI native left/right code through source metadata; if ambiguous stop before scoring, never guess
class_mapping.probability_epsilon: bias log clips at1e-9, unchanged frozen rule

channel_mapping.operation: mapped[n,i,t]=sum_j M[i,j]*raw[n,j,t]; exact matches direct, missing channels fixed IDW4; no target fitting; verify raw channel order before use; bipolar FC3-CP3 and FC4-CP4 from exact original target channels

block_balance_check.before_inference: From unlabelled metadata freeze person/session1/block/phase/trial/time order and block boundaries, no label access. If native boundaries ambiguous stop and document.
block_balance_check.after_prediction_lock: Separate scorer reads permitted session1 labels, enumerates left/right counts for every previously frozen block, validates unique trial identity and total, writes counts and imbalance fraction.
block_balance_check.report: All blocks retained; unequal left/right counts flagged and separately summarized with n,prior and effects. Primary remains all preregistered persons/blocks; no exclusion, reweighting or prior adaptation based on balance. Missing-class blocks retained with kappa undefined explicitly, not silently dropped.

secondary_analyses.soft_TV: For each person and each panel/block compute abs(mean(p_left)-.5) before correction; n-weighted over blocks then equal-mean9 panels for one person feature; correlate54 persons with per-person mean9-panel causal and batch ACC gains by Spearman. Report rho and leave-one-person-out range; exploratory.
secondary_analyses.decision_changes: For each person/panel/method count argmax changed, wrong-to-right, right-to-wrong, wrong-to-wrong. Corrected fraction=wrong-to-right/all decision-changed, null if zero. Also wrong-to-right/(wrong-to-right+right-to-wrong). Pool counts over nine panels explicitly as repeated panel-trials, and report per-person rates; never call repeated panels independent people.
secondary_analyses.benefit_harm: 54-person fraction with mean9-panel ACC gain strictly>0.01; fraction harmed gain<0; ties separately; report mean gain itself and by-person distribution for both methods. No metric-based selection.
secondary_analyses.within_person_panel_order: score each panel before averaging, no choosing best source fold or trialwise oracle

archive: Public timestamped GitHub commit on a dedicated preregistration branch; exact PLAN.json plus SHA manifest, public commit URL and GitHub server commit receipt stored locally. No EEG, labels, models or predictions published.

channel_mapping_provenance.generation_algorithm: MNE standard_1020 coordinates; exact matches16, missing6; choose nearest4 among20 target channels by Euclidean distance, weights normalized inverse-squared distance; no EEG and no labels in calculation
channel_mapping_provenance.independent_reconstruction: Recomputed from current installed MNE standard_1020; maximum absolute matrix difference1.1102230246251565e-16
channel_mapping_provenance.generation_time_evidence: Local filesystem records MAPPING.npy and PROTOCOL.json created/last-written2026-11-15T01:58:08Z (09:58:08 Asia/Shanghai). Local timestamps are not trusted external timestamps and do not prove original creation. Historical REPORT mtime2026-11-15T03:04:57Z.
channel_mapping_provenance.decision_record: Historical protocol states single locked mapping, no alternative sweep, source unchanged. PACKAGE_LOCK pins mapping and protocol. Geometry-only computation independently verified. Original standalone generator script not found in scoped audit; no independent tamper-proof timestamp before historical scoring.
channel_mapping_provenance.target_label_selection: No evidence found of selecting the matrix by OpenBMI labels or session2 scores; historical protocol explicitly forbids it. However absence of every possible prior label-guided design decision cannot be independently proved; session2 had historical exposure. Do not claim fully audited lifetime absence of such influence.
channel_mapping_provenance.current_decision: Reuse this exact archived matrix with its SHA; never search mappings, donors or weights during current study.

effect_size_wording: Primary verdict unchanged: lower95%CI>0迁移成立; crossing or touching0中性; upper95%CI<0有害. If lower95%CI>0 and mean ACC gain<0.01, additionally describe as方向一致、幅度小. Mean exactly0.01 does not trigger small-effect phrase.

interruption_handling.permitted: Only fix engineering errors unrelated to outcomes, such as IO, isolation, device/runtime compatibility, serialization or progress reporting, while preserving algorithms, trial set, mapping, constants and registered analyses.
interruption_handling.restart: After any engineering fix, invalidate current run artifacts as analysis inputs, retain them in a failure archive, and rerun the entire preregistered54-person×9-panel inference/calibration workflow from beginning; do not selectively retain successful persons or panels.
interruption_handling.after_scoring: Never modify rules or numerical constants after any score is seen. If an error affects validity after scoring, disclose it, archive the result as invalid and stop for a new plan and user confirmation rather than adjust based on score.
interruption_handling.logging: Record error, discovery phase, whether labels/scores had been opened, exact code diff and hashes, reason the fix is outcome-independent, complete-run identifiers.
